title: Candy
description: Distribute candies to children with different ratings such that every child gets at least one candy and children with higher ratings get more than their neighbors.
pseudocode:
1: candies = Array(n).fill(1)
2: for i = 1 to n-1: if ratings[i] > ratings[i-1]: candies[i] = candies[i-1] + 1
3: for i = n-2 down to 0: if ratings[i] > ratings[i+1]: candies[i] = max(candies[i], candies[i+1] + 1)

steps.note: Left-to-right pass: 1 > 0? No. 2 > 1? Yes, update index 2.
Right-to-left pass: 1 > 2? No. 0 > 1? No. No changes needed.
